dcterms:description: Market-1501 contains 32,668 labeled images of 1,501 identities collected from 6 cameras, with 12,936 images from 751 identities used for training and 19,732 images from 750 identities plus some distractors forming the gallery/database.
dcterms:title: Market-1501

dcterms:description: DukeMTMC-reID has 36,411 labeled images belonging to 1,404 identities collected from 8 cameras, with 16,522 training images from 702 identities and 2,228 query images from another 702 identities.
dcterms:title: DukeMTMC-reID

dcterms:description: CUHK03 contains 14,096 images of 1,467 identities, with each identity captured from two cameras. The dataset has two train/test settings: using labeled bounding boxes and using DPM detected bounding boxes.
dcterms:title: CUHK03
